why: The answer gets one thing right, that braces are optional for this single-statement body. It never says the code is legal or why, and its blanket claim that braces are 'pointless' is wrong as a style rule, because without braces only one statement belongs to the if.

concepts.quote: Braces are pointless, I never write them.
concepts.why: Braces really are optional around one statement, but they are needed for a body with more than one statement, and S&W and TJ advise using them even for one.
It hints at the rule that an if body without braces may be a single statement, but it never applies this to the question of whether the code is legal.
The answer says nothing about statements or the count++ statement.
The answer does not check the code against the if template.
